advisory.finding: The non-Mode comparison branch (`if not isinstance(other, Mode): return NotImplemented`) added to __le__, __gt__, and __ge__ (and present in __lt__) has no test. Because Mode subclasses str, comparing a Mode against a bare string or int is a genuine behavioral fork the guard resolves; the new test only compares Mode-to-Mode, so a regression that dropped the isinstance guard (letting str's inherited ordering handle e.g. `Mode.LIVE < "bootstrap-strict"`) would go undetected.
scenarios: A refactor drops the isinstance guard from a dunder; Mode.LIVE < "bootstrap-strict" silently uses str ordering instead of returning NotImplemented
